source: English voice (US PlayStation release), transcribed by whisper.cpp large-v3

lines.text: Oh, that's the tenth time we've tried. Maybe we should just give up.
I got all excited when I heard that What's-His-Name the Monkey came
back from outer space and was going to give us ancient technology.
But it just doesn't seem to live up to all the hype.
Hmm, going to the stars. A task not easily undertaken.
Yes, but it looks like they're on the right track to me.
